stem.text: What is an example of plastic deformation?

A.text: A rubber ball is momentarily compressed every time it hits the ground.

B.text: A spoon stirring some coffee in a ceramic mug hits its surface and makes a clinking sound.

C.text: A toolbox is left on a horizontal plank. When the toolbox is removed, the plank is no longer straight.

D.text: The spring in some bathroom weighing scales is compressed by a person standing on the scales.
